effect_description_eng: ＜Progress＞＜Piercing＞ ＜Engage＞ (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack.) [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] This Digimon gets +6000 DP until your opponent's turn ends. Then, by returning 1 of your other Digimon or 1 [Jesmon] or [X Antibody] from this Digimon's digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side.
